action.name: C06-FIX-A versioned availability-time amendment
action.objective: Reconstruct only defensible publication/available-time metadata for the 45 already-frozen official C06 snapshot titles, create a non-overwriting descendant amendment, and structurally validate the 2015-2019 inner origins before any empirical access.
prerequisites: PAIR-A complete PIT all-pairs selected by the researcher
allowed_scope: read immutable official CSRC/CAPCO snapshot pages and manifests already acquired
bounded official reacquisition only where existing first-party evidence cannot establish availability
create a versioned C06 availability metadata descendant with explicit CORE-DATASET-FREEZE-V1 ancestry
account for all 45 titles and all 1125 rows with null old publication metadata
validate C06 membership-state constructibility at the ten frozen 2015-2019 semiannual origins
update lineage, validators, governance state, and documentation without changing membership contents
normal non-force commit and push to the authorized origin main
resume the already-authorized Phase 1 inner workflow only if every required origin passes
forbidden_scope: infer dates from period labels, period ends, archive-page dates, neighboring dates, or current pages
mutate CORE-DATASET-FREEZE-V1 or its bound C06 artifact
change C06 membership, taxonomy, identity, scope 34/35, PAIR-A, or any G4/G5 semantic
inspect realized pair counts except a mechanically necessary C06 membership-state existence check
model fitting or any market, relationship, abnormality, mechanism, target, return, or PnL computation
change the 2015-2019 calendar or drop unresolved origins
action.commit_scope: Versioned C06 availability amendment, structural PIT validation, lineage/governance/validator updates, and action-state transitions only.
action.push_reason: Researcher explicitly authorized normal commit/push after C06-FIX-A validation; destination remains the authorized origin main and force/history rewriting are prohibited.
action.completion_condition: All ten 2015-2019 inner origins are PIT-constructible and the amendment is frozen/published before Phase 1 resumes, or an exact unresolved-origin integrity checkpoint is published.
mandatory_stop_conditions: Any empirical, OF4, or held-out access
Any silent C06 timestamp repair or frozen-artifact mutation
Any snapshot date lacking independent first-party evidence
